placements.why: This envelope's entire content is a technical infrastructure decision (database selection for an analytics pipeline, its performance rationale, and its rollout timeline). No strata category exists yet in this repo, and none of the other canonical organizational buckets (Opportunity, Strategy, Product, Organization, Proof, Templates, Calibration) plausibly cover a system-design/technology-selection decision the way Architecture does. Minted standalone since a strata mint needs no parent of its own.
placements.title: Infrastructure and system design decisions
placements.frame: What technical architecture or infrastructure choice is being made, and what problem is it solving for the system?

placements.title: analytics database modernization driven by columnar-query performance
placements.frame: What performance gap or capability shortfall is motivating a change of database technology, and does the chosen replacement's justification and rollout hold up as it plays out?
placements.why: src-1/src-4 name the adopted system (Zypherion) for the analytics pipeline; src-2/src-5 give the performance rationale (columnar-query speedup) driving that choice; src-3/src-6 give the migration timeline that operationalizes it. Together these are one coherent, ongoing subject — a database technology shift justified by measured performance and carried out on a schedule — that future envelopes reporting on the migration's progress, further performance results, or timeline changes would keep feeding, rather than a one-off fact. No existing leaf or strata sub-area in this repo covers it, so it mints fresh under the newly minted Architecture strata rather than proliferating separate leaves for the decision, the metric, and the schedule, which are all facets of the same theme.
